EmailTemplate.name: College Attainment Grant Awarded
EmailTemplate.subject: Congratulations on receiving the College Attainment Grant!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
You have been awarded the College Attainment Grant Program (https://students.asu.edu/cagp) at Arizona State University. Our mission at ASU is to make college as affordable as possible. With this grant, there is no need for repayment and it will provide for your tuition and fees for up to four years.
Your Financial Aid Notification is posted in My ASU (http://my.asu.edu/) under your Finances tab. Your next step is to act on your awards. Please take advantage of our Student Budget Worksheet (https://students.asu.edu/financialaid/budget) to determine if you want to accept, modify or decline any part of your financial aid package.
Complete your Priority Tasks in My ASU (http://my.asu.edu/):
-pay your enrollment deposit* (https://students.asu.edu/freshman/deposit) -confirm your housing preferences at (https://housing.asu.edu/) -sign up for orientation at (https://eoss.asu.edu/orientation) -take the math placement test (https://students.asu.edu/math) -submit your MMR immunization records (https://eoss.asu.edu/health/services/immunization)
*As a Federal Pell Grant recipient, you have the opportunity to defer your enrollment deposit (https://asu.secure.force.com/kb/articles/FAQ/How-do-I-defer-my-enrollment-deposit/?q=enrollment&l=en_US&fs=Search&pn=1).
If you have any questions regarding your FAN, please feel free to contact me or Financial Aid and Scholarship Services at https://students.asu.edu/contact/financialaid. I'd also be happy to discuss the costs and how to pay for your education.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
